headlines.title: White House warns congressional Democrats: Investigating us may be a crime
headlines.description: Previewing the partisan battles to come, the White House fired a warning shot at House Democrats’ top investigator Wednesday.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth and others reprimanded by guard at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth was reprimanded Wednesday by an Army sentinel guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier who asked him and his guests to maintain “atmospheric silence and respect.”

headlines.title: Delaware residents file lawsuit seeking a second House seat for the First State
headlines.description: A pair of Delaware voters filed a lawsuit Tuesday against Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick in an effort to increase Delaware’s representation in Congress.

headlines.title: How soon could Mississippi's Senate race be decided?
headlines.description: NBC News correspondent Priscilla Thompson joins Meet the Press NOW from Jackson, Mississippi to report on the remaining votes for the state's Senate race as Scott Colom (D) pulls further ahead of incumbent Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith (R) in the count.

headlines.title: Trump admin, Republicans are 'scared' of oversight and 'lashing out': DCCC chair
headlines.description: As Congressional Democrats discuss plans for oversight of the Trump administration in the new year, the White House warns that threats to investigate could be illegal. Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee Chair Rep. Suzan DelBene (D-Wash.) tells Meet the Press NOW the response does not “change our resolve.”

headlines.title: Republicans ‘feel like they did not go hard enough to the right’ after midterm loss
headlines.description: NBC News correspondents Ryan Nobles, Monica Alba and Sahil Kapur join Meet the Press NOW to report on the growing leadership fight between Democrats on Capitol Hill, how Republicans plan to govern in the minority and where the White House thinks they went wrong in the midterms.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Pro-Palestinian protesters pelt objects at Biden outside Irish university
headlines.description: Three men have been arrested after protesters pelted objects at former President Joe Biden during protests outside a university in Dublin, police in Ireland said.

headlines.title: Kennedy family members seek to block construction of Trump’s arch
headlines.description: Nine family members seek to join a lawsuit against the arch, arguing it would cast a shadow over the site where some of their notable relatives are buried.

headlines.title: U.S. charges 3 men with plotting multiple terror attacks, including on British air base
headlines.description: One of the men helped direct the planned attack against the air base while he was in a U.S. prison, according to a Justice Department indictment.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. María Elvira Salazar wins re-election in Florida after clashing with Trump
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Salazar defeated her Democratic opponent in a heavily Hispanic, Miami-based district that Trump carried by 15 points in 2024.

headlines.title: How North Carolina emerged as one of Democrats’ biggest midterm bright spots: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki digs into battleground North Carolina’s massive midterm shift toward Democrats.
